title: Split Plugin Wasm Into Shared Framework Component and Thin Plugin Components
description: Design and implement splitting the ~230 MB plugin wasm build into a stable, cacheable framework component and thin per-plugin components, so the edit→browser loop for a plugin change drops below 10 minutes. Measure today's edit→browser time for one plugin and where the 230 MB comes from (per-crate size, duplicated framework code per plugin), propose the component boundary (component model / wasm linking) schema-first, implement it for one plugin end to end, and prove the time with before/after numbers. Done = one plugin rebuilt and reloaded in the browser in < 10 min after a plugin-only edit, framework component reused from cache, written up in the ticket folder. Origin: fleet wave 1127 proposal-review item 2 (ticket 26/11/13 FLEET-ONE-MACHINE-SHARED-HOT-CACHE-AND-REMOTE-EXECUTION).
